lines.text: Papa ke antim sanskaar mein chhiyaalis log aaye the, aur main unmein se ek ko bhi nahi jaanta tha.
Woh log bhi ek doosre ko nahi jaante the.
Lekin Ma ne kisi se kuch nahi poochha.
Phir ek buzurg aage aaye, Papa ke pairon ko haath lagaaya, aur wahin baith kar rone lage.
Baar baar bas yahi keh rahe the ki woh Papa ke paise kabhi lauta nahi paaye.
Papa ne ikatees saal bus chalaayi thi, aur unke bank khaate mein sirf do sau baarah rupaye the.
Pehli baar laga ki main apne Papa ko jaanta hi nahi tha.
Teen hafte baad bank ka notice aaya. Papa ne ghar girvi rakha tha, aur mujhe bataaya tak nahi.
Ikkis lakh chukaane the, saintalis din mein. Warna ghar chala jaayega.
Usi raat maine Papa ka puraana baksa khola.
Wardi ke neeche unki peetal ki ghanti thi, jise woh mujhe kabhi chhoone nahi dete the.
Aur sabse neeche, ek laal kapde ki diary.
Andar naam the, tareekhein thi, aur har naam ke aage ek rakam.
Maine jod kar dekha. Adtees lakh, chaalis hazaar.
Do sau baarah rupaye waala aadmi, adtees lakh baant gaya?
Naam gine toh saintalis nikle. Aur bank ne kitne din diye the? Saintalis.
Lekin pehle panne par Papa ne bas itna likha tha, ki kisi se paise mat maangna.
Aur aakhri naam ko kisi ne itni baar kaata tha ki kaagaz hi phat gaya tha.
Main wahi panna dekh raha tha jab Ma darwaaze par aa gayi, aur dheere se boli ki diary waapas rakh do.
Unki aawaaz kaanp rahi thi. Maine Ma ko itna dara hua kabhi nahi dekha tha.
Maine diary waapas nahi rakhi.
Pehla naam hai Shankar. Kal main unse milne jaa raha hoon.
